items.q: Where are the protons found in an atom?
items.qAf: Waar word die protone in ’n atoom gevind?
items.explain: Protons and neutrons are in the nucleus at the centre; electrons move around it.
items.explainAf: Protone en neutrone is in die kern in die middel; elektrone beweeg rondom dit.

items.q: What is the charge of an electron?
items.qAf: Wat is die lading van ’n elektron?
items.explain: Electrons carry a negative charge, protons a positive charge, and neutrons no charge.
items.explainAf: Elektrone dra ’n negatiewe lading, protone ’n positiewe lading, en neutrone geen lading nie.

items.q: An atom has 8 protons and 8 electrons. What is its overall charge?
items.qAf: ŉ Atoom het 8 protone en 8 elektrone. Wat is sy totale lading?
items.explain: Equal numbers of positive protons and negative electrons cancel out, so the atom is neutral.
items.explainAf: Gelyke getalle positiewe protone en negatiewe elektrone hef mekaar op, so die atoom is neutraal.

items.q: Which atomic model shows electrons moving in fixed orbits around the nucleus?
items.qAf: Watter atoommodel wys elektrone wat in vaste bane om die kern beweeg?
items.explain: Bohr’s model places electrons in energy levels, or shells, around the nucleus.
items.explainAf: Bohr se model plaas elektrone in energievlakke, of skille, om die kern.

items.q: An atom has atomic number 11 and mass number 23. How many neutrons does it have?
items.qAf: ŉ Atoom het atoomgetal 11 en massagetal 23. Hoeveel neutrone het dit?

items.q: Which number tells you how many protons an atom has?
items.qAf: Watter getal sê vir jou hoeveel protone ’n atoom het?
items.explain: The atomic number is the number of protons in the nucleus, and it identifies the element.
items.explainAf: Die atoomgetal is die aantal protone in die kern, en dit identifiseer die element.

items.q: The positively charged particle in the nucleus of an atom.
items.qAf: Die positief gelaaide deeltjie in die kern van ’n atoom.

items.q: The particle in the nucleus that has no charge.
items.qAf: Die deeltjie in die kern wat geen lading het nie.

items.q: The tiny, dense centre of an atom.
items.qAf: Die klein, digte middelpunt van ’n atoom.

items.q: The number of protons in an atom.

items.text: In the model of Rutherford, most of the atom is empty [[]], with the electrons moving around a small positive [[]].
items.textAf: In Rutherford se model is die meeste van die atoom leë [[]], met die elektrone wat om ’n klein positiewe [[]] beweeg.

items.q: Electrons are found inside the nucleus.
items.qAf: Elektrone word binne die kern gevind.
items.explain: False. Electrons move around the nucleus; only protons and neutrons are in the nucleus.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Elektrone beweeg om die kern; net protone en neutrone is in die kern.

items.q: An electron has a much smaller mass than a proton.
items.qAf: ’n Elektron het ’n baie kleiner massa as ’n proton.
items.explain: True. A proton is about 1 800 times heavier than an electron.
items.explainAf: Waar. ’n Proton is omtrent 1 800 keer swaarder as ’n elektron.

items.q: All atoms of the same element have the same number of protons.
items.qAf: Alle atome van dieselfde element het dieselfde aantal protone.
items.explain: True. The number of protons (the atomic number) decides which element an atom is.
items.explainAf: Waar. Die aantal protone (die atoomgetal) bepaal watter element ’n atoom is.

items.q: Put these atomic models in the order in which they were proposed, oldest first.
items.qAf: Rangskik hierdie atoommodelle in die volgorde waarin hulle voorgestel is, oudste eerste.
steps: Dalton: atoms are solid, indivisible spheres
Bohr: electrons in fixed energy levels
stepsAf: Dalton: atome is soliede, ondeelbare bolle
